summary.zh: Whole Foods 现成派皮 · 170°C／约 340°F · 40 分钟
summary.en: Ready-made Whole Foods pie crust · 170°C / about 340°F · 40 minutes

name.zh: Whole Foods 购买的现成派皮
name.en: Ready-made pie crust purchased at Whole Foods

steps.zh: 派馅配现成派皮，170°C／约 340°F 烤 40 分钟。派皮预处理依所用产品包装要求。
steps.en: Fill the ready-made pie crust and bake at 170°C / about 340°F for 40 minutes. Prepare the crust according to its package instructions.

steps.zh: 上次成品甜度不足，下次需要增加糖量。
steps.en: The last pie was not sweet enough; increase the sugar next time.

steps.zh: 先试额外加入 30 g 糖。先与栗子泥、南瓜泥拌匀，在加入鸡蛋前尝甜度，再按所用栗子泥和南瓜泥的甜度调整。
steps.en: First try adding an extra 30 g sugar. Mix it with the chestnut and pumpkin purées, taste before adding the egg, then adjust according to the sweetness of the purées.

notes.zh: 原手写配方未列额外糖量。栗子泥当时是否含糖已记不清，保留为不确定。派皮品牌及尺寸待补。
notes.en: The handwritten recipe does not list additional sugar. It is unclear whether the chestnut purée used was sweetened. The crust brand and size still need to be recorded.

notes.zh: 额外 30 g 糖为本次整理时提出的试做建议，尚未验证。原始烘烤时间也需结合实际模具和派皮观察。
notes.en: The extra 30 g sugar is a trial suggestion added during transcription and has not been tested. Check the baking time against the actual pan and crust.
